info.title: EU Disclosure Atlas API
info.description:
Open, unified data on insider trading (MAR Article 19) and short selling (SSR Article 6) across European
markets. Natural persons appear only as pseudonymous ids. Every response is pinned to a data snapshot,
exposed in the `ETag` and `X-Atlas-Snapshot` headers. Transaction and issuer endpoints accept `?as_of=<snapshot>`
to answer from an earlier snapshot, so published figures stay reproducible. Not investment advice.

get.description:
Daily prices of the issuer's share, plus the days on which its insiders bought or sold on the market.

Prices come from a pluggable provider (yfinance in development) and are cached in the lake's reference
area. They are unadjusted closing prices of the listing on the issuer's home market. Not investment advice.
Gold tables available as Parquet for the current data snapshot.

schema.title: Response List Exports V1 Exports Get

get.description: One gold table as Parquet (zstd). Supports `Range` requests, so DuckDB reads it remotely.

Model scores of recent insider-trade events, newest first.

The `insider-signal` model (research/signals/MODEL_CARD.md) estimates, for each open-market buy or sell
event, the probability that the share beats the market over the next 20 sessions. Out of sample it is
barely better than a coin flip: read `model.metrics` before reading any score. Research output, not
investment advice.
